# John Russel L. Angulo (JRLA)

> Portfolio of John Russel L. Angulo ("Jano"), a front-end developer and UI/UX designer from Bulacan, Philippines, who also edits video and draws vector art. Open to roles from 2026 onwards.

The site at https://jrla1219.web.app/ is a single-page Vue app with five panels: Home, Features, Works, About, Contact. Its content renders client-side, so this file is a plain-text summary of it.

## About

- Name: John Russel L. Angulo. Goes by Jano. Mark: JRLA.
- Based in Bulacan, Philippines.
- Disciplines: front-end development, UI/UX design, video editing, vector art.
- Experience: UI Engineer at CoreProc, Inc. (2022 to present). Freelance video editor on Upwork (2021 to July 2022).
- Education: BS Information Technology, Bulacan State University (2018 to 2022).

## Skills

- Front-end: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Sass, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, Vue.js, Next.js, React, GSAP, Laravel, WordPress, Git, Docker
- UI/UX: Figma, Adobe XD, Adobe Illustrator. Wireframes, interactive prototypes, design systems, accessibility.
- Video: Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe After Effects, Adobe Media Encoder. Commercials, interviews, testimonials, 2D motion graphics.
- Vector art: Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Wacom tablet. Illustrations, logos, brand material.
- AI tools: Claude
